verdict.rationale: PayPal's developer docs show strong API coverage for core business functions—checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, disputes (via Disputes API), and webhooks—giving programmatic parity for many merchant workflows. However, several UI-surfaced consumer features (Pay in 4, PayPal Savings, group money pooling, Payment Links 'no coding skills required', debit card rewards, in-person tap-to-pay) are only described as UI/app experiences with no evidenced REST API equivalent, and the Resolution Center is explicitly marketed as a 'no-code' web-only alternative to the Disputes API rather than full API parity. missing for 10: API equivalents for Pay in 4, Savings, group pooling, Payment Links, and confirmation the Resolution Center's full functionality is API-accessible.
